title_sq: Tek Rruga E Durresit, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Ideal Per Banim Ose Investim!!
description_sq: Tek Rruga E Durresit Perballe Hotel Colosseo, Shitet Apartament 2+1 Ideal Per Banim Ose Investim!!! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 te nje pallati me 5 kate te mireadministruar pa ashensor. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe 82 m2 dhe organizohet nga korridori shperndares, salloni ndenjes bashke me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet dhe 1 ballkon. Apartamenti eshte i investuar totalisht duke filluar nga instalimet elektrike dhe hidraulike, tualeti i rikonstruktuar totalisht, parket, dyer, dritare si dhe mobilimi bashke me elektroshtepiaket. Zona ne te cilen ndodhet apartamenti eshte nga me te kerkuarat pasi ofron te gjitha facilitetet e duhura per nje jetese sa me komode si dhe per investim duke qene se ka kerkesa te larta per qira. Cmimi i prones eshte 16.800.000 Leke te reja. Apartamenti disponon dokumentacion te rregullt hipotekor.
title_en: On Durres Street, 2+1 Apartment For Sale, Ideal For Residence Or Investment!!
description_en: On Durres Street in front of Colosseo Hotel, 2+1 Apartment for Sale Ideal for Living or Investment!!! The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a well-managed 5-story building without an elevator. The apartment has an area of ​​82 m2 and is organized by a distribution corridor, a living room with a kitchenette, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and 1 balcony. The apartment is fully invested, starting from the electrical and plumbing installations, the completely reconstructed toilet, parquet, doors, windows, as well as the furniture together with the appliances. The area in which the apartment is located is one of the most sought after as it offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable life as well as for investment as there are high demands for rent. The price of the property is 16,800,000 new Lek. The apartment has regular mortgage documentation.
